places.name: Waitwell
places.note: suggested for the Bus-strong county (county_a): where the province waits for the bus, and waits well

places.name: Pane End
places.note: suggested for the Shops-strong county (county_b): a county of shop windows

places.name: Cloche Vale
places.note: suggested for the Vegetables-strong county (county_c); a cloche is a glass cover for seedlings

places.name: Dawdlemouth
places.note: suggested for the Anglers-strong county (county_e): where the River Dawdle reaches the canal

places.name: Clatterby
places.note: suggested for the Bus-and-Brass county (county_f): buses and bands both clatter

places.name: Lower Wobbling
places.note: suggested for the Shops-and-Vegetables county (county_g): a county of Upper Wobbling, which nobody explains; the longest county name (14)

places.name: Wobbling Stone
places.note: written 'the Wobbling Stone': the rocking stone the province is named after; serves no club

places.name: Empty Plinth
places.note: written 'the Empty Plinth': a plinth outside the provincial hall, kept free for something (vanity papers; never filled in a paper, the statue ration is 1 per deck)

places.name: Fourth Bandstand
places.note: written 'the Fourth Bandstand': nobody can find the other three; Brass

places.name: Tiptoe Jetty
places.note: written 'Tiptoe Jetty': the quietest jetty on the canal; Anglers

places.name: Unhurried Canal
places.note: written 'the Unhurried Canal': the province's canal (office-style.md 1)

places.name: Lingering Locks
places.note: written 'the Lingering Locks': a flight of locks on the Unhurried Canal; boats wait in them, anglers watch

places.name: Great Glasshouse
places.note: written 'the Great Glasshouse': the oldest of the glasshouses; Vegetables

places.name: First Shelter
places.note: written 'the First Shelter': the province's oldest bus shelter, kept as it was and leaned on; Bus

places.name: Glass Arcade
places.note: written 'the Glass Arcade': a covered row of shop windows; Shops

runUp.text: Open the {district} fête. The ribbon was cut early, to save time.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Point at something in {district}. Rodney will decide what, later.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Throw your hat in at the {district} hat parade. Not that hat.
runUp.subject: hats

runUp.text: Open the {district} bridge. Again for the camera. Again for luck.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Pin the {district} show rosette on the winner. Not on you.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Cut the {district} fête cake. The icing says THE GOVERNOR CUT THIS.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Feed the {district} ducks. Rodney has asked them to look pleased.
runUp.subject: ducks

runUp.text: Sign the {district} roll of honour on a napkin, like the founders.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Sit with the {district} Anglers. Say nothing. You will be quoted.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Tour {district}: 14 benches, and not one with your name on it yet.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Plant a tree in {district}. The spade is gilded. The tree is extra.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Applaud every band at the {district} contest. And every tuning-up.
runUp.subject: bandstands

runUp.text: Cut the {district} ribbon. Cuthbert needs both halves signed for.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Pose with the {district} prize pumpkin. It prefers the left.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Open the {district} flower show. It is open. Open it officially.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Wave off the {district} 7:02. Twice; it may have missed the first.
runUp.subject: buses

rallies.text: A rally at the bandstand. Rodney has set out 40 chairs, and one for your hat.
rallies.subject: bandstands

rallies.text: A rally at the show. Stand on the hay bale marked GOVERNOR. Wave the scissors.
rallies.subject: ceremonies

rallies.text: A rally on the green. Cuthbert has the scissors, the ribbon and a form for each.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: Hold a rally by the empty plinth. Stand near it. Not on it. Not yet.
rallies.subject: vanity
